adjacentPathways.label: Duration-Sensitive Rate-Cut Proxies
adjacentPathways.transmissionPath: Inflation surprises reprice the central-bank path, which then rerates bond duration, housing affordability, REIT financing, and other rate-sensitive assets.
adjacentPathways.reason: The topic is the rate-path expression of the existing inflation theme, but it adds a reusable duration-sensitive market pathway rather than a distinct new canonical theme.
adjacentPathways.thesis: This topic is not a new canonical theme because inflation data and policy repricing already sit inside Global Inflation Regime Shift. The reusable addition is the cross-asset duration channel: softer inflation lifts odds of cuts, lowers real and nominal yields, and supports long-duration bonds, homebuilders, and rate-sensitive real estate over multi-week to multi-quarter windows. The pathway is durable because each inflation cycle, policy meeting, and growth scare repeatedly flows through the same valuation and financing mechanisms.
invalidation: Core inflation re-accelerates and central banks reprice to higher-for-longer policy paths.
Long yields keep rising on term premium or fiscal supply even if policy cuts begin, breaking the usual duration transmission.
Housing or real estate demand weakens for credit or labor reasons that overwhelm lower-rate support.
transmissionChannels: Inflation surprise -> central-bank path repricing -> Treasury duration rerating
Inflation surprise -> mortgage rate repricing -> housing affordability and builder demand
Inflation surprise -> refinancing cost and cap-rate changes -> REIT equity rerating
Inflation surprise -> real yield compression or expansion -> long-duration equity multiple changes

assets.name: iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF
assets.transmissionPath: Softer inflation directly lowers expected terminal rates and long-end yields, lifting duration-heavy Treasuries.

assets.name: SPDR S&P Homebuilders ETF
assets.transmissionPath: Lower rate-cut thresholds feed into mortgage-rate relief and improve housing affordability, supporting builders and related suppliers.

assets.name: Real Estate Select Sector SPDR Fund
assets.transmissionPath: Falling policy-rate expectations reduce refinancing pressure and support property valuations through lower discount rates and cap-rate compression.

assets.name: Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund
assets.transmissionPath: A renewed higher-for-longer inflation path usually supports the dollar and partially offsets losses in duration-sensitive longs.
